description: This file defines a React component `ImageDiffView` for displaying image differences, including side-by-side comparison, diff view, slider, and other modes. It handles loading images, rendering diff overlays, and user interaction for image comparison in a testing or visual regression context.

classes.name: ImageDiffView
classes.description: React functional component for visualizing image differences with various modes like diff, side-by-side, and slider.

classes.name: ImageDiffSlider
classes.description: React component providing an interactive slider overlay for comparing expected and actual images.

classes.name: ImageWithSize
classes.description: Subcomponent for rendering an image with optional size display.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an image from a URL and resolves to an HTMLImageElement.
